title: V5: align cluster transport heartbeat to seal_interval (attester 1500→1000)
brief: Debug root cause (docs/debug/20260531-v5-cy-proposer-quorum-wait-root-cause.md): proposer seal_interval_ms=1000 but attester keeps transport default heartbeat_interval_ms=1500 because apply_cluster_timing only adjusts heartbeat for ClusterRole::Proposer. Proposer wastes ~2 ticks/seal in quorum_pending (~50% suppression, ~1.57s/block). Fix: when cluster.enabled, cap heartbeat_interval_ms via cluster_prop_ms(seal_ms, …) for ALL roles (proposer, attester, follower).

primary_change.before: heartbeat cap only if matches!(role, Proposer)

design.formula_unchanged: cluster_prop_ms = min(heartbeat_ms, seal_ms) — with seal_ms=1000 and default 1500 → 1000
non_goals: RFC16 pipeline attest / decouple seal from attest (V6+)
Change quorum k/n or attest_timeout formula

acceptance_criteria: apply_cluster_timing sets heartbeat_interval_ms for attester role to seal_ms when bph=3600
Unit test: cluster enabled + Attester → heartbeat_interval_ms == 1000
docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md: heartbeat must match seal_interval on all CY nodes
Optional live verify: restart attester+proposer; grep cluster_attest on both logs for heartbeat_interval_ms=1000
operator_verify: Restart CY attester then proposer; within 2–3 min watch seal_suppression_summary suppression_pct drop and sealed height cadence ~1/s

delegation.invite_note:
V5 CY HEARTBEAT ALIGN — pwm-coding (preliminary fix from debug RCA).

Root cause: docs/debug/20260531-v5-cy-proposer-quorum-wait-root-cause.md — attester heartbeat 1500ms vs proposer seal 1000ms; apply_cluster_timing only fixes proposer.

Fix lifecycle.rs apply_cluster_timing: when cluster.enabled, always set transport.heartbeat_interval_ms = cluster_prop_ms(seal_ms, transport.heartbeat_interval_ms) (remove Proposer-only guard).

Test + runbook. Live: both nodes log heartbeat_interval_ms=1000; suppression_pct should fall.
